items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Creed didn't want me there. He said stop the presses, so I stopped. About three or four weeks later Stan called and said, how's it going? I told them they said to stop, so he must have gotten on with Creed and it was on again and then it went.

ctx.x: Creed Taylor. Creed didn't want me there. He said stop the presses, so I stopped.
About three or four weeks later Stan called and said, how's it going? I told him they said to stop, so he must have gotten on with Creed and it was on again and then it went.
